Decision
No source-level safety blocker was found in the opt-in FULLPREFILL success/fail-stop sequence inspected. This is not execution evidence or a claim that the 262144-row run works on hardware. R419’s physical endpoint-store witness is absent: the code and completion record correctly label the evidence callback coverage only and endpoint_store_proof=0. The arm cannot qualify numerical output or prove the KV payload stored at physical cell 262143.

Admission and request parsing
- Startup opt-in is default-off: STRATA_PHASE_FULL_CONTEXT_PROBE must equal "1"; when on, early raw-option validation requires phase cache, head lease, layer-major, scratch alias, serve, fixed 4096/8192 capacity, explicit reserve exactly 700 MiB, and excludes 12K, standalone full-context/MTP probe, graph/GPU/stage modes, suffix/lookup drafting, ordinary input tokens, capture/dump modes, and first-row capture (generate.cpp:2495-2510). Existing bounded phase/layer-major gates separately retain context262144, int8 KV resident32768, no MTP/no borrowing/no reuse/single GPU and native profile requirements (2520-2550, 2534-2550, 4191-4250). The environment check runs before model/device allocation.
- The diagnostic loop handles every non-QUIT line only in its dedicated branch. It accepts the literal prefix FULLPREFILL 0 followed by a comma/whitespace-separated list; parse_i64_list rejects non-integer, negative, overflow, and empty tokens, and the arm validates every parsed id against n_vocab (generate.cpp:774-792, 8338-8350). The request must contain exactly 262144 IDs, output field zero, and prior successful request count zero (phase_serve_cycle.hpp:50-54). The parser’s source-owned vector stays alive across the synchronous Prefill::run and is released on normal scope exit. Malformed requests print ERR and continue without beginning the lease or advancing cycle.requests().
- A successfully accepted request reaches begin_gen, which increments requests; successful completion stores the completed chunk count and breaks out of the serve loop. Thus a subsequent request is never processed; it enters common QUIT/close. The helper independently rejects any nonzero prior request. No ordinary GEN parsing or max_new path is reached after the arm accepts FULLPREFILL (generate.cpp:8338-8413).
- The request protocol hardcodes output=0 and does not rely on CLI --max-new. In serve mode --spec must still be >=2 and initializes the ordinary Verifier at startup (generate.cpp:5994-6001, 6268-6277). The diagnostic gate requires suffix-draft and lookup-chain off, so raw --spec 4 stays 4 rather than expanding through normal suffix-draft normalization. The FULLPREFILL arm itself never calls Verifier, head forward, sampler, MTP/draft, decode, or RESTORE; it checks unchanged dispatch call/layer and draft-round counters (8370-8396). There is no effective verifier window in this arm (zero verifier windows), despite the process having a raw verifier capacity of four. No generated token is emitted. This distinction should be retained in any run receipt: raw spec capacity is configuration, not evidence of a one-row verifier window.
- Ordinary GEN rules are unchanged in this arm: phase fresh GEN requires 2 <= n < 262144, pin=0/PCIe0 and context admission; generic context admission also requires n+max_new<=262144 (generate.cpp:2886, 3590, 8780-8830 vicinity). FULLPREFILL is an opt-in-only distinct command and with the opt-in off is rejected by existing phase/layer-major request-kind checks. No prompt-size limit or output budget is weakened for ordinary GEN.

Prefill extent and callback correctness
- The selected prefill mode is fixed layer-major. Its dedicated mode flag requires exactly n=262144, pos0=0, physical max_cells=262144 and a completion callback; ordinary layer-major requests retain existing extent rules (prefill.cpp:1435-1443; layer_major.hpp:85-88). The arm checks configured chunk equals the admitted capacity and that the phase owner is leased with mapped_slots()==0 before run (generate.cpp:8383-8389).
- It replaces the ordinary phase callback with a non-null final-layer callback that only accepts contiguous chunks: begin must equal the previous end; every count is positive and <= capacity and in bounds; final completion requires end==262144, stats.tokens==262144, measured chunks equal observed chunks, mathematically exact chunk count, and final begin+count==262144 (phase_serve_cycle.hpp:20-38; generate.cpp:8377-8396). This avoids the ordinary successor-token callback reading cur[p0+t+1] past the terminal input row (comment at generate.cpp:8377-8382).
- Prefill’s callback executes only after compute-stream synchronization of each final-layer chunk (prefill.cpp:3377-3387). After run returns the arm checks both stream_sync and device_sync. Layer-major’s Restore guard drains both compute and copy streams before restoring borrowed pointers and destroying its private expert cache, residual bridge and staging/source owners; a failed drain uses cleanup_require fail-stop rather than freeing possibly active buffers (prefill.cpp:1480-1505). This review did not establish a physical write receipt for each KV endpoint cell; callback/count coverage is a work-progress witness only.

Lease lifecycle and failure handling
- Before prefill, phase_cycle.begin_gen calls quiesce, reader graph retirement, head release, physical cache detach/begin_prefill lease and fixed workspace reinitialization in the wired order. session_zero_checked zeros R/GDN/QSA/PLE state and is followed by stream synchronization before Prefill::run (session.cpp:167-188; generate.cpp:8125-8319, 8371-8376). The arm rechecks actual fresh/ownership/session state and rejects MTP, images/stage callbacks, reused session/checkpoint/slot state, split and failure flags (generate.cpp:8347-8371).
- On successful prefill, successful_prompt quiesces and calls retire_workspace (sp.reset, retaining SessionState), then finishes prefill by remapping/filling/publishing the 144-slot baseline, reloads the head, maps/fills/publishes 912 extras, and flips cycle state to decoding (phase_serve_cycle.hpp:95-108; callback wiring generate.cpp:8158-8318). The caller checks workspace retired, no prefill lease, exactly 912 mapped slots, ready/unpoisoned readers and persistent session geometry/state before complete_gen(true) (generate.cpp:8399-8406).
- Exceptions from the full-context arm are caught and sent to phase_fatal. phase_fatal flushes diagnostics and calls std::_Exit(1), retaining owners on uncertain work rather than unwinding them (generate.cpp:4191-4196, 8412-8413). Prefill Restore’s failed drain also fail-stops. This is consistent with the stated unknown/failure ownership policy.
- After successful completion, break reaches ordinary checked QUIT: quiesce, reset prefill workspace only if not already retired, retire graphs, and phase_close. Only after phase_close succeeds does the program print FULLPREFILL_DONE ... callback_coverage_only owner_closed (generate.cpp:11017-11047). Close failure is fail-stop and cannot emit DONE. If stdin closes after success, the same close path is used. An already-buffered later input line is not handled because success intentionally exits the request loop.

Evidence boundary / action before qualification
This report is source inspection only. It did not establish compile correctness, test fixture correctness, runtime output, physical memory fit, actual 262144-token acceptance, latency, endpoint KV write, numerical quality, or recovery under injected faults. The existing registry-v195 itself says prior actual L phase0 lifecycle passed with no quality/256K/speed proof, and this full-context report is listed there as an implementation report, not a completed measurement. Keep R419 endpoint witness separate; do not treat callback coverage or owner close as a proof of the last physical KV value. Build, fixture, CLI/no-new, and hardware/fault validation remain for Main’s authorized sequence.
